_note: Prices in USD. Edit freely; the app never fetches live prices. 'verified' records where/when a price was checked.

gpt-6.1-sol.notes: Reasoning tokens are billed as output and count against max_output_tokens. The app charges cached input at the full input price (deliberate overstatement).

search._note: Search APIs bill separately from the model. Price per 1,000 requests. null = unknown: requests are still counted and limited by number, but not counted in the dollar budget.

tavily.basis: app uses search_depth=advanced = 2 credits per request; pay-as-you-go $0.008/credit -> $0.016/request (checked 2026-10-01). Requests within Tavily's free monthly credits cost $0, so this deliberately overstates real spend.
